statement: For continuous type-preserving autoequivalences of the explicit labelled/coloured completed covering-and-filling category E.8, preserving its finite labelling groupoids, permutation quotients and specified deletions, identity of the complete genus-zero outer-action system implies identity of every outer mapping-class action. Restriction is faithful on these induced outer systems.
manuscript_passages: 142; manuscript pp.7-10; scans15-21; especially scan17 and Z142f/R26 puncture-forgetting structure
notes: Integrated after complete parent review; independent scoped review in audit/E_chosen_sheet_topos_review.md. No historical manuscript attribution or priority assertion. This is faithfulness of the complete genus-zero system, not an identification of every such system with GT, not GT=G_Q, and not a lifting theorem for genus-zero conjugators. The marked connected-fibre Hurwitz assertion is proved directly by functions with reduced pole divisor and jets of length at most2n+4. The cancellation proof uses ordinary pi1/homotopy-to-isotopy before E.6 completion, and assumes no CSP or profinite DNB.
